cohort: 140 pregnant women with heart disease and pulmonary hypertension undergoing cesarean section
finding: Pregnant women with heart disease and pulmonary hypertension experienced significant hemodynamic changes during cesarean section, and several factors were identified as independent risk factors for heart failure, including hypoproteinemia, increased BNP, anemia, reduced ejection fraction, heart structure changes, cardiac function above III grade, moderate-severe pulmonary hypertension, rheumatic heart disease, and systolic time interval.
